articles.title: Cleveland Clinic becomes official healthcare provider of PGA TOUR
articles.summary: Cleveland Clinic and the PGA TOUR have entered a long-term partnership aimed at expanding health, wellness and performance services for professional golfers. Under the agreement, Cleveland Clinic will serve as the official healthcare provider for the PGA TOUR and PGA TOUR Champions and will also act as the TOUR’s performance partner.
